families.name: smooth_sum_powers
families.method: exact least representative lifts followed by 9S residue; no full-witness filters

families.name: complete_cycle_gcd
families.generation: G=gcd(7*10^a-18*10^b-25,10^d-1); remove all powers of 7; use G/3^j for every 0<=j<=v_3(G)
families.candidate_domain: S>=31, S=3 mod7, L=(S+4)/7 odd, S%5!=0, L mod d=a
families.method: all generated candidate sums; recover r_K and evaluate full 9S residue directly

stopping_rule: Complete exactly these finite ranges; no scan enlargement prompted by absence of a counterexample. No factorization or discrete logarithm beyond linearized 7-adic lifts is needed.
scope_rationale: Smooth sums test tractable inherited exponent families across growing K. Cycle-gcd sums deliberately seek small full-sum exponent periods relative to S, improving on blind length extension; only maximal gcds with variable three-parts are claimed, not every divisor.
